title: Swedish Quiz: What Is This Called? (Reflex) | SvenskaVardag
text:
What is this small thing on Swedish jackets called? 🔦 Pick A or B before the answer!

📝 "En reflex! Den syns i mörkret."
↳ A reflector! You can see it in the dark.

🎓 en reflex = a reflector, syns = can be seen
